name: Pacific Northwest Modern
definition: A regional interpretation of modern design that brings forest, stone and water into a comfortable home.
materials: white oak; basalt; oatmeal wool; forest-green woven fabric; black steel
living: forest-green tailored sofa; round dark-oak coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular dining table and six oak chairs; black shallow dome pendants
bed: oak spindle beds, ivory linen, forest-green throws, landscape art
solarium: teak slatted outdoor chairs with forest-green cushions and teak dining table
implement: Keep the existing oak and black framing; deepen the green textiles and add one substantial landscape artwork.
avoid: Avoid log-cabin motifs and heavy live-edge slabs in the narrow shared room.

name: Japandi
definition: Japanese restraint and Scandinavian comfort expressed through quiet proportions, natural materials and useful objects.
materials: light oak; walnut accents; linen; rice paper; matte clay
living: oatmeal low tailored sofa; round walnut coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular dining table with six woven-seat oak chairs; white paper globe pendants
bed: low oak queen beds, ivory linen, muted olive throws, one ink landscape
solarium: teak chairs with oatmeal cushions and teak dining table
implement: Reuse the birch beds and paper lights; simplify art groupings and repeat oak, linen and olive.
avoid: Do not remove useful storage to achieve empty surfaces.

name: Warm Scandinavian
definition: Light, practical Nordic rooms softened by tactile textiles and warm wood rather than stark white.
materials: pale ash; birch; wool; cotton; opal glass
living: pale sage tailored sofa; round pale-oak coffee table; pale-oak media cabinet; pale-ash rectangular dining table and six spindle chairs; opal globe pendants
bed: birch spindle beds, white cotton, blue-gray throws, simple botanical prints
solarium: light teak chairs with sage cushions and matching table
implement: Keep most current furniture; add washable wool-look textiles, light blue accents and diffused lamps.
avoid: Too many white surfaces can flatten the room; maintain warm timber contrast.

name: Organic Modern
definition: Modern simplicity with rounded silhouettes and the texture of stone, wood and natural cloth.
materials: oak; travertine; boucle; linen; matte plaster
living: cream softly rounded sofa; round travertine coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular dining table with six curved oak chairs; cream sculptural pendants
bed: cream upholstered queen beds, sand linen, olive throws, textured abstract art
solarium: teak chairs with cream cushions and teak table
implement: Introduce one rounded upholstered anchor and a tactile rug while retaining the cream kitchen.
avoid: Keep sculptural furniture compact; large curved sofas can consume circulation.

name: Warm Minimalism
definition: A reduced palette and carefully chosen forms, with warmth supplied by texture and light.
materials: oak veneer; wool felt; linen; satin stone; matte metal
living: sand straight-arm sofa; round taupe stone coffee table; flush oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six simple upholstered chairs; small linen drum pendants
bed: flat oak queen beds, ivory bedding, taupe throws, one tonal print
solarium: teak chairs with taupe cushions and simple teak table
implement: Use concealed storage and fewer, larger accessories; match wall and textile undertones.
avoid: Minimal does not mean eliminating bedside lighting or practical storage.

name: Biophilic Contemporary
definition: Contemporary interiors organized around daylight, landscape views, botanical color and tangible natural materials.
materials: oak; cork; linen; green ceramic; textured wool
living: olive woven sofa; round oak coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular dining table with six green upholstered chairs; woven natural pendants
bed: oak queen beds, ivory linen, moss throws, botanical artwork
solarium: teak outdoor chairs with moss cushions, teak dining table, clustered planters
implement: Frame the lake view with a few plants and repeat green inside; keep plants off door tracks.
avoid: Check actual light and watering needs before purchasing plants.

name: Mid-century Modern
definition: A lasting modernist vocabulary of tapered legs, functional storage and expressive but economical shapes.
materials: walnut; teak; cognac leather; woven wool; aged brass
living: cognac leather sofa on slim legs; round walnut coffee table; walnut sliding-door media cabinet; walnut rectangular table and six curved-back chairs; opal saucer pendants
bed: walnut queen beds, ivory cotton, ochre throws, geometric prints
solarium: teak chairs with ochre cushions and teak table
implement: Trade one anchor for walnut or cognac and connect it to the current ash chairs.
avoid: Avoid making every object a recognizable retro icon.

name: Scandinavian + Mid-century
definition: Nordic lightness combined with the warmer color and elegant joinery of mid-century furniture.
materials: oak; walnut; wool; linen; opal glass
living: muted blue-green sofa; round walnut coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six curved-back chairs; opal saucer pendants
bed: oak queen beds, cream cotton, caramel throws, graphic landscapes
solarium: teak chairs with blue-green cushions and teak table
implement: Retain oak dining furniture, add walnut at the coffee table and caramel textiles.
avoid: Limit contrasting woods to two clear families.

name: Contemporary Wabi-sabi
definition: A contemporary interpretation of the Japanese appreciation of impermanence and imperfect materials; understated, tactile and personal.
materials: weathered oak; linen; clay; limewash effect; rough stone
living: flax linen sofa; round weathered-oak coffee table; quiet oak media cabinet; weathered-oak rectangular table with six woven-seat chairs; handmade paper pendants
bed: low oak queen beds, undyed linen, earth-brown throws, subtle ink art
solarium: weathered teak chairs with flax cushions and teak table
implement: Choose irregular ceramics and softly textured walls; keep the room functional and uncluttered.
avoid: Avoid manufactured distressing everywhere or treating a cultural philosophy as a prop theme.

name: Belgian Linen Minimalism
definition: Relaxed European restraint with generous linen, muted stone colors and worn wood.
materials: washed linen; weathered oak; limestone; wool; dark bronze
living: flax slipcovered sofa; round aged-oak coffee table; aged-oak media cabinet; oak rectangular dining table and six linen-seat chairs; linen drum pendants
bed: linen upholstered queen beds, ivory linen, mushroom throws, quiet landscape art
solarium: weathered teak chairs with flax cushions and table
implement: Use tailored slipcovers, matte ceramics and tonal textiles against existing cream cabinetry.
avoid: Keep slipcovered pieces shallow enough for this condo.

name: Quiet Luxury Contemporary
definition: Polished, restrained interiors whose richness comes from proportion, material quality and subtle contrast.
materials: walnut; wool; honed stone; linen; brushed bronze
living: warm ivory tailored sofa; round honed brown-stone coffee table; walnut media cabinet; walnut rectangular dining table and six taupe upholstered chairs; bronze and opal pendants
bed: taupe upholstered queen beds, ivory bedding, chocolate throws, large tonal art
solarium: dark teak chairs with taupe cushions and table
implement: Keep black marble and cream millwork; add walnut and better layered lighting.
avoid: Gloss and decorative gold can overwhelm the restrained effect.

name: Soft Contemporary
definition: Current clean-lined design with comfortable curves, balanced color and accessible materials.
materials: oak; woven upholstery; ceramic; wool; satin nickel
living: dusty blue-gray sofa; round oak coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six taupe curved-back chairs; frosted-glass pendants
bed: taupe upholstered queen beds, cream cotton, blue-gray throws, soft abstract art
solarium: teak chairs with blue-gray cushions and teak table
implement: Use softer seating and abstract art while preserving the current open arrangement.
avoid: Avoid oversized sectionals and many competing curves.

name: Modern Coastal
definition: Airy interiors with sand, faded blue and natural fibers, without literal nautical decoration.
materials: white oak; linen; woven rope; cotton; sea-glass accents
living: ivory linen sofa; round white-oak coffee table; white-oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six woven chairs; woven pale pendants
bed: oak queen beds, white cotton, faded-blue throws, abstract water art
solarium: teak chairs with sea-blue cushions and teak table
implement: Let the lake view supply the water reference; use sandy textiles and restrained blue.
avoid: Avoid ropes, anchors and beach signs as themed decor.

name: Modern Mediterranean
definition: A contemporary take on sunwashed mineral finishes, earthy ceramics and relaxed woven furniture.
materials: cream plaster; terracotta; oak; linen; woven rush
living: cream linen sofa; round pale-stone coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six rush-seat chairs; woven pendants
bed: oak queen beds, ivory linen, clay throws, earthy abstract artwork
solarium: teak chairs with clay cushions and table, terracotta planters
implement: Introduce clay through cushions and pots and mineral texture through paint samples.
avoid: Do not add arches or change windows to simulate a villa.

name: Modern Rustic
definition: Simple contemporary furniture paired with rugged wood, wool and earthy color.
materials: reclaimed-look oak; wool; leather; stone; iron
living: camel woven sofa; round rustic-oak coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six leather-seat chairs; black metal dome pendants
bed: oak queen beds, ivory bedding, olive wool throws, landscape art
solarium: teak chairs with camel cushions and teak table
implement: Add texture with a rug and wood accent; keep the existing smooth cabinets as visual relief.
avoid: Avoid bulky farmhouse tables or faux beams under the 2.7 m ceiling.

name: Warm Transitional
definition: Classic comfort simplified by modern lines, mixing traditional upholstery with restrained contemporary finishes.
materials: oak; linen; wool; aged brass; marble
living: cream tailored sofa with slim rolled arms; round dark-oak coffee table; oak media cabinet; oak rectangular table and six upholstered chairs; linen drum pendants
bed: linen upholstered queen beds, ivory cotton, sage throws, framed landscapes
solarium: teak chairs with cream cushions and teak table
implement: Pair understated classic fabrics with current cream cabinets and black counters.
avoid: Keep trim modest; elaborate moldings would fight the condo's simple shell.

name: Modern Heritage / New Traditional
definition: Familiar traditional patterns and vintage character edited for a modern apartment.
materials: walnut; small-scale botanical cloth; wool; ceramic; aged brass
living: olive tailored sofa; round walnut coffee table; walnut media cabinet; walnut rectangular table with six cream upholstered chairs; pleated linen pendants
bed: oak queen beds, ivory quilt, muted burgundy throws, vintage botanical prints
solarium: teak chairs with olive cushions and table
implement: Start with a patterned rug and framed art, keeping large furniture simple.
avoid: Layer two pattern scales at most in each small bedroom.

name: Parisian Contemporary
definition: An edited mix of graceful vintage pieces, contemporary upholstery and artistic detail.
materials: walnut; ivory linen; marble; brass; muted velvet
living: ivory curved-arm sofa; round marble coffee table; walnut media cabinet; walnut rectangular table and six taupe upholstered chairs; brass and opal pendants
bed: ivory upholstered queen beds, white linen, dusty-mauve throws, abstract black-line art
solarium: dark teak chairs with ivory cushions and teak table
implement: Use one antique-style mirror or lamp and expressive art rather than recreating a period apartment.
avoid: Keep ceilings and openings unchanged; avoid oversized chandeliers.

name: Contemporary Art Deco
definition: Geometric rhythm, rich color and refined metal details adapted to compact contemporary rooms.
materials: walnut; emerald velvet; ribbed glass; marble; brushed brass
living: emerald channel-backed sofa; round dark-marble coffee table with brass base; walnut media cabinet; walnut rectangular table and six emerald chairs; ribbed-glass pendants
bed: emerald upholstered queen beds, ivory bedding, bronze throws, geometric art
solarium: dark teak chairs with emerald cushions and teak table
implement: Echo the existing fluted cabinets with ribbed glass and a small number of brass accents.
avoid: Use geometry in textiles rather than adding bulky decorative construction.

name: Curated Eclectic / Maximalism
definition: A personal mix of eras, pattern and saturated color held together by recurring hues and deliberate scale.
materials: walnut; patterned wool; velvet; ceramic; antique brass
living: burgundy velvet sofa; round walnut coffee table; walnut media cabinet; walnut rectangular table and six olive upholstered chairs; ochre pleated pendants; jewel-tone patterned rug
bed: oak queen beds, cream bedding, burgundy patterned throws, curated colorful gallery art
solarium: teak chairs with burgundy cushions and table, colorful pots
implement: Use burgundy, green and ochre repeatedly; concentrate the gallery on an uninterrupted wall.
avoid: Keep circulation and glass clear; maximalism needs storage and editing.
